title: Sprint gating and skill-debt reserve policy for peak-cycle stabilization
creator: Ayesha Patel
description:
Problem: During high-concurrency launches and cross-team peak windows we repeatedly oversubscribe specialist roles (infra, runtime, SDK) which forces last-minute scope cuts or ad-hoc overtime. Current cycle hedges are informal (on-call swaps, volunteer overflow) and create uneven risk distribution and product debt.

Proposal: Define a formal Sprint Gating + Skill-Debt Reserve Policy that: 1) creates a small, pre-allocated pool of specialist-hours (the Reserve) per cycle; 2) defines objective Gate criteria for advancing major initiative slices into execution; 3) provides a lightweight, time-boxed mechanism for graceful decommits that preserves critical-path features with minimal knowledge transfer.

Goals: Reduce mid-cycle emergency decommits by 60% for cross-team initiatives, shorten scope-trim decision latency to <48 hours, and make staffing trade-offs auditable. Policy includes: reserve sizing formula, gate checklist, decommit cadence, stakeholder sign-off flow, and a playbook for applying reserve hours.

Reserve sizing heuristic (draft): ReserveHours = ceil( (Sum(initiative_estimates) * 0.07) + specialist_friction_estimate ). Default minimum = 40 specialist-hours per cycle (two FTE-weeks), adjustable by cycle velocity and org risk score.

Gate checklist (pass/fail signals):
- Proposed scope has owner and primary engineer listed
- Cross-team dependencies identified and owner assigned
- SLO/regulatory blockers flagged and mitigations in backlog
- Risk score <= threshold OR Reserve hours requested with justification

Graceful decommit flow: 1) Initiate decommit request in Cycle Board with triage score; 2) PM, Eng lead, and Delivery partner convene within 24 hours; 3) If decommit accepted, apply knowledge preservation steps (contracts, transfer ticket, document links) and optionally consume Reserve hours to preserve critical behaviour.

Metrics and dashboards: number of reserve hour draws, average decision latency for decommits, variance in specialist FTE utilization, and number of post-release regressions traced to mid-cycle decommits. Dashboard prototype: /dashboards/cycle-reserve (Grafana).

Rollout plan: pilot for two cycles (2026-W12, 2026-W14) scoped to Platform & Console initiatives, retrospective after pilot to iterate sizing and gate thresholds. Full org rollout in Q3 if pilot metrics show >40% reduction in emergency staffing spikes.
